title: Implement authoritative Project resource
final_head_policy: The exact final pushed PR head and exact-head GitHub Actions runs are recorded in the PR/final handoff; later pushes invalidate earlier CI evidence. This file does not contain its own SHA to avoid self-referential evidence.

branch_protection.note: Ruleset verified via repository ruleset API before edits; legacy branch-protection endpoint returned 403. No mutation needed.

project_authority_model.identity: Server-generated UUID via newId() / randomUUID, never client/provider supplied
project_authority_model.ownership: Canonical organizations.id FK, organization_memberships proves tenant membership on every decision
project_authority_model.timestamps: Server-controlled created_at/updated_at, updated_at refreshed on mutation
project_authority_model.integrity: FK to organizations, CHECK name non-empty, provider authority keys rejected
project_authority_model.tenant_safe_reads: listProjectsForOrganization scoped to canonical organization_id; getProjectById returns canonical row for authz to resolve tenant
project_authority_model.tenant_safe_mutations: createProject requires organization membership via authz; updateProject requires project membership via authz

persistence.server_authority: id via newId(), timestamps via now(), organizationId via requireId, name via requireNonEmpty, rejectProviderAuthority

authorization_integration.project_tenant_resolution: ProjectRow.organizationId resolved from persistence, then OrganizationRow resolved, then membership required
authorization_integration.decision_boundary: TenantAuthorizationService.authorize returns explicit allow/deny, never throws for outcome

negative_paths.forged_organization_id: unknown_resource or no_membership via FK and authz
negative_paths.forged_project_ownership: tenant resolved from persistence, not client claim
negative_paths.stale_tenant_info: client org claim ignored, canonical persistence used

authorization_integration.service_layer: @vibeflow/project ProjectService uses authz for create (org check) and read/list/update (project check)

audit_integration.authorization_audit: AuthorizationAuditRecorder records project decisions; organization_id resolved via SELECT organization_id FROM projects WHERE id = $1
audit_integration.server_authority: actorAccountId canonical, resourceId canonical UUID, organizationId resolved from canonical row, not client metadata
audit_integration.scope_resolution_failure: Database errors while resolving canonical Organization or Project tenant scope propagate to TenantAuthorizationService; an otherwise-allowed decision is converted to DENY audit_unavailable instead of writing an unscoped allowed event. Missing resources still resolve to zero rows and may remain account-scoped denial evidence.
audit_integration.metadata_safety: sanitizeAuditMetadata omits secret keys and redacts secret values, rejects authority-shaped keys
negative: Project audit scope database failure denies authorization

api_service_boundary.exposed: Minimal CRUD for unbound/empty Project; no Artifact, import, binding, lifecycle E2E, delete/archive
client_supplied: organizationId (checked via membership, not trusted as authority)

unit.decision: 13/13 PASS after M-012 update (was 13/13 for M-010, now includes project)

retained_gate_stabilization.m005: Replaced a current-branch assertion that permanently required M-011 active with durable M-001..M-005 DONE + exactly-one-active-mission invariants.
retained_gate_stabilization.m007: Historical M-007 fixture now reconstructs all 405 accepted capability statuses in one pass instead of manually resetting capability IDs advanced by later missions.
retained_gate_stabilization.authorization_unknown_type: Retained M-010/M-012 unknown-resource-type tests now use a reserved test-only sentinel instead of canonical resource names such as project/workspace/task that can become supported later.
retained_gate_stabilization.security_strength: No fail-closed or negative-path assertion was weakened; only historical/current-state coupling was removed.

runners: pnpm run check executes all package Vitest suites, including packages/audit/src/project-scope.live.test.ts
scripts/run-m012-project-integration.py runs persistence, authorization, project live suites

suites.persistence: packages/persistence/src/project.live.test.ts 8 cases: canonical creation, ownership, FK, tenant-safe list, unknown UUID, mutation, indexes, provider authority rejection
suites.authorization: packages/authorization/src/project.live.test.ts 10+ cases: same-tenant success, cross-tenant read/mutation fail, forged org/actor, unknown, revoked, canonical persistence, non-member, unauthenticated
suites.project_service: packages/project/src/project.live.test.ts 11 cases: creation, same-tenant read, cross-tenant read/mutation fail, forged org/actor, unknown, revoked, stale tenant, canonical persistence + audit scoping, tenant-safe list
suites.audit_scope_failure: packages/audit/src/project-scope.live.test.ts proves a forced canonical Project audit-scope query failure converts an otherwise-valid ALLOW to audit_unavailable and persists no false allowed Project audit row

live_postgres.status_at_evidence_creation: NOT EXECUTED locally (no DATABASE_URL); must be executed in CI exact-head; not represented as PASS

local_checks.pnpm_install: PASS (with --no-frozen-lockfile to update lock for new @vibeflow/project dep)
local_checks.test: 16/16 packages PASS (live skipped without DB, expected)

capability_status.VF-IAM-010: IMPLEMENTED (Project ownership: canonical org ownership + membership resolution)
capability_status.VF-PRJ-016: NOT_STARTED (Project Profile beyond name not in M-012 scope)
capability_status.rationale: M-012 implements authoritative Project existence, id, org ownership, timestamps, FK, indexes, tenant-safe CRUD and authorization. Artifact, import, full lifecycle, bindings remain LOCKED.

known_limitations: Project update only supports name change; no full lifecycle state machine (M-015).
Audit for project uses organization_id resolved from projects table; project-specific audit catalog beyond authorization remains future.
PostgreSQL live suites require DATABASE_URL and are not executed locally; CI must run them exact-head.
M-012 remains REVIEW, not DONE, until independent review and merge.
out_of_scope_confirmed: M-015 full Project lifecycle E2E beyond M-012 not implemented
M-016+ provider bindings: AgentBinding, ModelBinding, WorkspaceBinding, RepositoryBinding, DataBinding, ObjectStorageBinding, DeploymentBinding not implemented

OpenHands integration, workspace provisioning, GitHub repo management, Monaco/web IDE, task/execution engine, Temporal, deployment, billing, collaboration roles/groups, enterprise SSO/SCIM, broad external authorization engine, later mobile/UI work not implemented
overclaim_check: M-012 is REVIEW, not DONE. VF-IAM-010, VF-PRJ-005, VF-PRJ-015 are IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED/COMPLETE. PostgreSQL live is not claimed locally. M-013+ remain LOCKED.
